prompt:
90 年代中国港式武侠漫画美术风格，2.5D 漫画质感，
墨线分明清晰，厚涂上色、色彩饱和鲜艳明亮，
人物五官立体，衣袂飘动有动势，
整体明亮通透、光影对比鲜明、阳光感强、色彩活力充沛，

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 2.5D walkable RPG scene background
Primary request: 第一章竹尾村主街，无文字纯场景
Scene/backdrop: 明亮的江南山村主街，青瓦木楼、客栈外廊、杂货棚和石板路构成可探索的小型集市，无人物。
Composition/framing: 45-degree isometric oblique view, wide horizontal scene, a continuous readable walkable route occupying at least 35 percent of the image, clear entrances and exits, gameplay-safe center area.
Lighting/mood: 午前清亮阳光，木结构暖色与山林冷青色对比鲜明。
Color palette: bright saturated wuxia comic colors with clear warm-cool contrast.
Key elements: 左侧客栈交谈空地，中部商人位置，右侧守卫位置，右下城西出口；招牌、旗帜、告示均为空白材质，无文字符号。
Constraints: no characters, no NPCs, no animals, no UI, no text, no signs with writing, no watermark; buildings and vegetation must not block the main route; all objects share one perspective and one shadow direction.
Avoid: tileset, atlas, sprite sheet, collage, broken architecture, dense clutter, flat concept-art composition, photorealism, low-poly cartoon, 现代服装，3D CG 渲染感，照片级写实，
网络红人脸，二次元萌系，迪士尼风，
水印，签名，文字乱码，
繁体中文，繁体字，traditional chinese characters，
错字，简化字写错，
整体灰暗，雾蒙蒙，低饱和，沉郁压抑，黯淡无光，灰蒙蒙的色调
